basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas. I have a strong interest in music, particularly synthesizers, and often spend my free time jamming out or exploring new music production techniques. I also enjoy watching indie TV shows like 'Reservation Dogs' and occasionally dive into tabletop gaming with friends, especially Demeo. I work from home, which gives me the flexibility to browse Reddit during random intervals throughout the day. Relationship-wise, I'm currently single and focusing on personal growth. I'm usually online in the evenings, after 7 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I graduated with a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for about 6 years. My passion for music and technology led me to self-teach music production, focusing on synthesizers. I enjoy learning through online courses and community forums.
